2608.27161.title: STAR : Sentence Translation Alignment Rate for Document-to-Document Machine Translation
2608.27161.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a shift from sentence-level to document-to-document (Doc2Doc) machine translation, promising improved global coherence. However, document-to-document generation in a single pass frequently suffers from structural misalignment, manifesting as sentence omissions or hallucinations that violate the core requirement of source-target correspondence. To address this, we introduce Sentence Translation Alignment Rate (STAR), an auxiliary metric that explicitly quantifies sentence-level structural fidelity. Building on this, we propose STAR-masked Preference Optimization (StarPO), a framework that ranks document-level hypotheses by structural quality and utilizes a dynamic alignment mask to focus optimization on misaligned segments. Experimental results across news and literary domains demonstrate that StarPO significantly enhances translation quality and structural integrity. Notably, StarPO allows compact models to surpass the performance of massive proprietary systems like GPT-4o while maintaining superior token efficiency.
2608.27161.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）使得從句子級別轉向文檔對文檔（Doc2Doc）機器翻譯成為可能，承諾改善全球一致性。<lb/>然而，單次生成的文檔對文檔翻譯經常遭受結構不對齊的問題，表現為句子遺漏或幻覺，違反了源目標對應的核心要求。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們引入了句子翻譯對齊率（STAR），這是一個輔助指標，明確量化句子級別的結構保真度。<lb/>在此基礎上，我們提出了STAR遮罩偏好優化（StarPO），這是一個通過結構質量對文檔級假設進行排名的框架，並利用動態對齊遮罩將優化集中於不對齊的部分。<lb/>在新聞和文學領域的實驗結果顯示，StarPO顯著提高了翻譯質量和結構完整性。<lb/>值得注意的是，StarPO使得緊湊模型的表現超越了像GPT-4o這樣的大型專有系統，同時保持了優越的標記效率。
